title: Inclination Sensor / Lean Angle Error
problem: Vehicle tilt/inclination sensor detects vehicle has fallen or is mounted incorrectly.
symptoms: Engine cuts out instantly; Fuel pump will not prime; Bike won't start
actions: Check if sensor is mounted upright; Inspect connector for moisture; Verify 5V supply and ground; Reset ignition switch
location: Under the seat or near the battery

title: ECU Power Supply Circuit Malfunction
problem: ECU detects unstable or interrupted main power supply voltage.
symptoms: Engine stalling; Instrument cluster resets; Hard starting; Multiple random sensor codes
actions: Check main battery terminals for tightness; Verify main fuse; Check ground connections; Test battery voltage under load
location: Near battery or main starter relay

title: Start Ability Malfunction / Delay
problem: Engine fails to start within the expected number of cranks under standard conditions.
symptoms: Long cranking before starting; Failed start attempts; Rough initial idle
actions: Check fuel pump pressure; Inspect spark plug condition; Verify starter motor health; Check battery cranking amps
location: Engine / starter motor assembly

title: Engine RPM Signal Processing Failure
problem: Internal ECU fault in processing the engine RPM signal from the crankshaft sensor.
symptoms: Erratic RPM reading on tachometer; Stalling; Fuel cut-off; Rev limiter activates early
actions: Inspect crankshaft sensor wiring; Clean stator area from metal particles; Check ECU pins; Test crankshaft sensor resistance
location: Left side engine stator cover

title: Primary Spark Plug / Coil 'A' Malfunction
problem: Fault detected in the primary ignition coil circuit (often Coil A in twin/triple spark engines).
symptoms: Engine misfire; Loss of power; Hard starting; Single-spark operation only
actions: Check Coil A connector; Measure primary winding resistance (0.5-3 ohms); Verify HT lead is secure; Swap coils to test
location: Under fuel tank or near cylinder head

title: Secondary Spark Plug / Coil 'B' Malfunction
problem: Fault detected in the secondary ignition coil circuit (Coil B on DTS-i twin spark engines).
symptoms: Reduced power at high RPM; Slight misfire; Decreased fuel economy; Engine runs rough
actions: Measure Coil B resistance; Check wiring harness from ECU to Coil B; Inspect spark plug B for carbon soot
location: Under fuel tank or right side of cylinder

title: Auxiliary Spark Plug / Coil 'C' Malfunction
problem: Fault in the third ignition coil circuit (Coil C on DTS-i Triple Spark engines like NS200/RS200).
symptoms: Marginal drop in throttle response; Increased emissions; Rough idle
actions: Measure Coil C resistance; Verify ECU triggering pulse; Inspect spark plug C gap
location: Under fuel tank or left side of cylinder

title: Fuel Pump Relay Circuit Malfunction
problem: ECU detects open circuit or short to ground in the fuel pump relay control line.
symptoms: Engine cranks but does not start; No priming sound when ignition is turned on
actions: Listen for pump prime; Test fuel pump relay for click; Check fuel pump fuse; Measure voltage at pump connector
location: Under the seat near the main fuse box

title: Idle Air Control System Malfunction
problem: The Idle Air Control Valve (IACV) is unable to maintain the target idle speed.
symptoms: High idle speed; Idle speed hunting (fluctuating); Engine stalling at traffic lights
actions: Clean IAC valve plunger and passage; Check for intake manifold air leaks; Verify throttle cable slack; Replace IAC valve
location: Mounted on top of the throttle body

title: MAF Sensor Circuit Low Input
problem: The Mass Air Flow sensor signal voltage is below the minimum operational range.
symptoms: Rich running; Black smoke from exhaust; Hesitation on acceleration; Poor fuel economy
actions: Check MAF connector for corrosion; Clean MAF sensor element with electronic spray; Verify 5V reference; Inspect air filter
location: Air filter housing or intake duct

title: MAF Sensor Circuit High Input
problem: The Mass Air Flow sensor signal voltage is above the maximum operational range.
symptoms: Lean running; Engine hesitation; High idle; Hard starting when warm
actions: Check for wiring harness short to 12V; Test sensor signal output; Inspect for intake leaks after MAF; Replace MAF sensor
location: Air filter housing or intake duct

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Circuit Failure
problem: No speed signal received by the ECU from the wheel speed sensor.
symptoms: Speedometer displays 0 or behaves erratically; ABS light stays on; Gear indicator incorrect
actions: Clean sensor tip and tone ring of metal dust/dirt; Check sensor air gap; Verify wiring connection to instrument cluster
location: Front fork caliper mount or rear wheel hub

title: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit Low
problem: The voltage from the TPS is lower than the expected closed-throttle baseline.
symptoms: Poor throttle response; Stalling when opening throttle; Jerking at low speeds
actions: Verify 5V reference to TPS; Adjust TPS position; Check connector pins; Replace TPS if resistance is erratic
location: Side of throttle body assembly

title: Fuel Injector Circuit Open - Cylinder 1
problem: The fuel injector electrical circuit has an open circuit (no current flowing).
symptoms: Engine misfire; Bike will not start; Starter motor turns over but engine doesn't fire
actions: Check injector harness connector; Measure injector coil resistance (11-16 ohms); Test ECU injector drive signal; Clean injector
location: Under fuel tank on the intake runner

title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit High
problem: The IAT sensor voltage is above the normal range (indicating an open circuit or unplugged sensor).
symptoms: Engine runs rich; Poor fuel economy; Misfire during warm-up; Hard starting
actions: Verify IAT sensor is plugged in; Check wiring for open circuit; Test IAT resistance (approx 2k ohms at room temp); Replace IAT
location: Inside the airbox assembly

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Circuit Malfunction
problem: ECU does not receive a pulse signal from the crankshaft position (pick-up) sensor.
symptoms: Engine cranks but will not start; No spark at spark plug; Fuel pump runs but no ignition
actions: Test pick-up coil resistance (typically 200-400 ohms); Clean stator magnet and pick-up sensor; Check wiring harness
location: Left engine stator cover assembly

title: O2 Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1)

title: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction
problem: The internal heating element of the oxygen sensor has a circuit failure (open/short).
symptoms: Engine takes long time to warm up; High emissions; Increased fuel usage on short trips
actions: Measure heater coil resistance across heater pins; Check for 12V supply to heater relay; Replace O2 sensor
location: Exhaust header pipe close to cylinder head

title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Malfunction
problem: ECU receives an invalid pressure reading from the fuel delivery system sensor.
symptoms: Engine stalling; Loss of power; Hard starting; Engine cuts out under acceleration
actions: Check fuel line connections; Test fuel pump pressure; Inspect pressure sensor connector; Verify fuel filter is clean
location: Inside the fuel pump module or fuel rail

title: MAP Sensor Range/Performance Issue
problem: The Manifold Absolute Pressure sensor reading is out of expected limits relative to throttle angle.
symptoms: Engine hesitation; Stalling; Fuel air mixture rich or lean; Backfiring
actions: Inspect MAP sensor vacuum hose for cracks or blocks; Check for manifold vacuum leaks; Clean sensor port
location: Throttle body or intake manifold

title: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold
problem: The catalytic converter is not reducing exhaust emissions within the required limits.
symptoms: Check engine light illuminated; Metallic rattling noise from exhaust; No noticeable performance drop
actions: Check for exhaust leaks before catalytic converter; Inspect O2 sensors; Avoid low quality fuel; Replace catalytic converter
location: Exhaust pipe silencer assembly

title: Idle Air Control System Fault
problem: The Idle Air Control Valve cannot regulate the bypass air to achieve target idle.
symptoms: Fluctuating idle speed; Engine stalls when coming to a stop; Low idle when cold
actions: Clean carbon build-up in throttle body and IACV passages; Check connector for corrosion; Perform IACV reset procedure
location: Attached to the side of the throttle body

title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Low
problem: The ECT sensor signal is shorted to ground or reporting excessively high temperatures.
symptoms: Engine temp indicator flashing hot; Radiator fan runs continuously; Engine runs rich
actions: Verify coolant level; Test ECT sensor resistance; Check harness for short to ground; Replace ECT sensor
location: Cylinder head or near thermostat housing

title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor High
problem: The ECT sensor signal is open circuit or reporting excessively cold temperatures.
symptoms: Engine temp indicator reads cold; Radiator fan does not turn on; Hard starting when hot
actions: Verify connector is secure; Test sensor resistance; Inspect wiring for open circuit; Replace ECT sensor
location: Cylinder head or near thermostat housing

title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit Malfunction
problem: The ECU is not receiving a signal from the camshaft position sensor.
symptoms: Hard starting; Stalling; Erratic engine performance; Misfires
actions: Check CMP sensor wiring and connector; Measure sensor output voltage during cranking; Replace CMP sensor
location: Top cylinder head valve cover

title: System Voltage Low / Charging Fault
problem: ECU detects battery voltage has dropped below the threshold for reliable operations.
symptoms: Dim lights; Speedometer resetting; ABS system disabled; Hard starting
actions: Test battery voltage (12.6V rest
location: 14V running); Check voltage regulator/rectifier; Inspect stator coil output

title: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit Low Voltage
problem: TPS sensor signal is lower than the calibration threshold for closed throttle.
symptoms: Engine hesitates when accelerating; Stalling; Erratic idle
actions: Verify TPS connector is dry; Adjust TPS base voltage; Replace TPS if resistance sweep is non-linear
location: Side of throttle body
